title: Charat Singh Tricks the Rohtas Garrison

blocks.text: This transition page moves into the Sar Buland Khan episode by following Charat Singh toward the Rohtas position. Charat Singh crossed the Jhelum, assessed the fort and its defenders, and then used feigned withdrawal and altered movement to make the Pathans misread his intent.

That deception matters more than brute force. By returning through another approach and closing in before the garrison can reset itself, he turns the confidence of the fort into vulnerability and panic.
The page therefore introduces the capture sequence through cunning rather than frontal assault. Control of timing, routes, and perception becomes the Sikh advantage before the fort is fully overrun.
